cand.title: Semana Internacional de la Construcción México (SICON) 2027
cand.excerpt: Rank 6: medium evidence and direct Expo Guadalajara relevance; venue is committed, so current-edition accessibility is constrained and the lead is not an assumed open room block.

quote.assumption: exa agent fixed effort=high (contact enrichment not included)

findings.namedBuyers: Two verified commercial intermediaries: Ana Sánchez-Terán and Fernando Gómez, both named under VENTAS / Contacto internacional in the official 2026 sponsorship dossier. They can route a hotel partnership proposal to the organizer; neither is verified as the accommodation contracting buyer. Elena Hurtado, Expo Guadalajara’s general director, is a documented executive sponsor of the event and a secondary escalation route, not a proven room-block buyer.
findings.futureEdition: Confirmed upcoming second Mexican edition: 20–22 April 2027, 10:00–18:00, Expo Guadalajara, Salón Jalisco A y B. These are activity dates in the venue calendar, independently supported by the organizer’s 17 April 2026 closing release; they are not publication dates. Within the requested horizon. No 2028 Mexican edition date was verified.
findings.hotelProductFit: Inference: Sheraton Guadalajara Expo is suited to business-travel guestrooms, exhibitor/staff stays and optional small client meetings around this urban B2B exhibition, rather than a resort-led incentive programme. Marriott describes proximity to Expo Guadalajara and publishes 12 event rooms, including Diamante with capacity 500. The organizer’s FAQ already recommends Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara, but does not identify an exact property URL or contract; confirm that this means the subject hotel. The 2026 event recorded more than 5,500 professional visitors, not 5,500 overnight guests. No room-night conversion or demand estimate is justified.
findings.venueCommitments: Expo Guadalajara publicly lists Salón Jalisco A y B for 20–22 April 2027. This is a published venue commitment, not evidence that accommodation is closed. The organizer’s lodging page advertises a special agreement with Barceló Guadalajara; its validity dates, allotment and exclusivity are not published, so a 2027 hotel contract cannot be asserted.
findings.historicalRotation: The inaugural Mexican edition took place 14–16 April 2026 at Expo Guadalajara; the second returns there 20–22 April 2027. This establishes two consecutive Mexican editions in the same destination, not a rotating-host programme or an independently verified long-term annual schedule. Do not import the Spanish parent fair’s edition history into the Mexican series.
findings.accommodationSourcing: Hotel sourcing status: UNKNOWN / UNCONFIRMED, neither proven open nor proven closed. Published pathway: the organizer’s lodging recommendations and direct hotel contacts; a special Barceló Guadalajara agreement is advertised without dated terms. The FAQ also lists Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara, RIU Guadalajara, Hotel Westin Guadalajara, Real Inn, Barceló and Hampton Inn Expo. A recommendation is not a contracted block. Approach the joint organizer through its event contact form or international commercial team to identify the accommodation lead and any invited-buyer lodging process; no appointed housing bureau, PCO/DMC, room-block RFP or booking allocation was verified.
findings.organizationStructure: Jointly organized by IFEMA MADRID and Expo Guadalajara: a trade-fair organizer/venue partnership, not an association-owned congress or a verified corporate incentive trip. CMIC and CANADEVI provide institutional support; that does not establish them as accommodation buyers. Expo Guadalajara is both co-organizer and exhibition venue. No separate PCO/DMC or housing agency was identified in the reviewed official materials.
findings.competitiveLimitations: Barceló Guadalajara has the strongest published hotel relationship: an advertised special agreement and location opposite Expo Guadalajara. Other named lodging options include Guadalajara Plaza Expo Business Class, Holiday Inn Express Guadalajara Expo and Fiesta Inn Guadalajara Expo, plus the FAQ hotels. These are competitive recommendations, not verified contracted incumbents or exclusive allocations. No sourced sell-out, capacity shortfall or overflow demand was found. The 2026 sponsorship dossier located official cocktails at Foro Expo; do not assume those functions are available to an outside hotel in 2027.
findings.recommendedSalesAction: First check the hotel’s own sales records to establish whether the public Hotel Sheraton Guadalajara recommendation refers to this property and whether a 2026 relationship exists. Then send Ana Sánchez-Terán and Fernando Gómez a concise lodging/optional-meetings proposal for 20–22 April 2027, using the published international sales channel. Ask them to introduce the person responsible for accommodation and the invited-buyer programme; confirm the Barceló agreement’s edition, exclusivity and whether supplementary hotels may participate. Request actual stay dates, room pickup and decision deadlines before quoting a block. Offer only inventory and meeting space internally confirmed by the hotel; do not describe this as an open RFP. If 2027 is closed, request the next accommodation review date without inventing a 2028 edition.
findings.currentEditionAccessibility: For the upcoming 2027 edition, the exhibition venue is already selected; relocation of the core exhibition is not the sales thesis. Guestroom and ancillary-meeting access remains unconfirmed. The Barceló agreement creates a competitive constraint, not proof that all hotel business is closed. The Sheraton FAQ mention gives a relationship-validation entry point, not evidence of open inventory or an existing contract. A strengthened invited-buyer programme is reported for 2027, but its accommodation arrangements are unpublished.
findings.futureCompetitiveCapturePotential: Inference: build a supplementary lodging/referral relationship for 2027 if the organizers permit it, and seek consideration before any later hotel agreements are renewed. The confirmed return to Guadalajara supports relationship investment, but no 2028 dates, hotel tender or venue rotation were verified. This is future competitive-capture strategy, not a confirmed future room block.
